correctness.rationale: Complete finite-tree proof: polyhedral KKT cells have averaging derivatives and all fused forests are locally realizable; edge-cut step indicators form an isometric ℓ1 coordinate basis for tree TV, so every derivative norm is a single cut variation. The computed boundary formula is exact, not a finite-sample extrapolation. Exact-rational checker exhausts 1,441 labeled trees through 6 vertices and separately verifies concrete KKT attaining pairs.

value.rationale: The exact invariant concerns robustness of a standard graph-TV denoiser under perturbations measured in the same edge-variation geometry used to define the penalty. The striking unbounded amplification on graphs of maximum degree 3 despite one-input variation reduction is a substantive structural boundary, not a generic projection-norm restatement; paths and stars provide sharp benchmark regimes.
